api.name: dedicateGuestVlanRange
api.description: Dedicates a guest vlan range to an account

params.name: account
params.description: Account who will own the VLAN

params.name: vlanrange
params.description: Guest VLAN range to be dedicated

params.name: projectid
params.description: Project who will own the VLAN

params.name: domainid
params.description: Domain ID of the Account owning a VLAN

params.name: physicalnetworkid
params.description: Physical Network ID of the VLAN

response.name: domainpath
response.description: path of the domain to which the guest VLAN range belongs

response.name: account
response.description: The Account of the guest VLAN range

response.name: domain
response.description: The domain name of the guest VLAN range

response.name: jobid
response.description: The UUID of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: jobstatus
response.description: The current status of the latest async job acting on this object

response.name: project
response.description: The project name of the guest VLAN range

response.name: domainid
response.description: The domain ID of the guest VLAN range

response.name: projectid
response.description: The project id of the guest VLAN range

response.name: physicalnetworkid
response.description: The physical Network of the guest VLAN range

response.name: zoneid
response.description: The zone of the guest VLAN range

response.name: id
response.description: The ID of the guest VLAN range
